purpose: Producer-facing boundary for one current Source8-equivalent family after a separate owner, reviewer and issuer selection

authority_inputs_from_others.owner_slot_release_receipt_sha256: required exact external receipt; no value selected here
authority_inputs_from_others.current_source_manifest_sha256: required independently signed current family; no value selected here
authority_inputs_from_others.reviewer_permit_sha256: required distinct exact-scope decision; no value selected here
authority_inputs_from_others.reader_mapper_context_grant_refs: protected references delivered only by their custodians; never passed as Docker argv, environment, labels or logs

namespace_intent_fields.volume_name: fresh daemon-managed local volume name, checked absent then label-bound
namespace_intent_fields.volume_created_at: daemon inspect observation, not a cryptographic volume ID
namespace_intent_fields.volume_marker_sha256: root-owned marker inside exact volume; public identity only
namespace_intent_fields.volume_root_dev_ino: measured by initializer and rechecked by writer
namespace_intent_fields.instances_dev_ino: measured UID/GID 20001 0700 directory, rechecked by writer
namespace_intent_fields.keeper_cid: created non-running read-only volume reference held across launch and terminal cleanup
namespace_intent_fields.instance_name: exact fresh run-<run_id> or independently reviewed family grammar
namespace_intent_fields.runtime_image_id: independently pinned image containing current T35/source code; probe image is not a runtime qualification
namespace_intent_fields.slot_lock_dev_ino: held OFD identity across source selection, signing, effect and terminal cleanup, not merely a named lock file

container_mounts./lab: the one output named volume, RW, only in the trusted writer container; no host bind
container_mounts./inputs/public: separate exact immutable public input volume, RO if selected
container_mounts./inputs/protected: separate custodian-staged protected input volume, RO only after authority/grant; not present in this probe
container_mounts./tmp: optional private tmpfs scratch with explicit retention policy

producer_output_binding.host_mountpoint: never exposed as a producer write path
required_witnesses: writer CID and exact Mounts Type=volume RW=true
new instance inode after mkdir and at first open/final readback

control_plane_assumption: Docker daemon API access is limited to trusted admission operators during the entire family lifecycle. The local volume driver permits another Docker-capable client to mount RW; the synthetic counterexample demonstrates that a same-UID holder then writes successfully. Container permissions or flock alone cannot make that peer impossible.
scope_boundary: This interface does not sign Source, issue Reader/Mapper/Context grants, release historical a/b ownership, adapt T35 external path semantics, install a lasting writer, or qualify T02/G01/G02.
